title: DGX Spark on driver 615.71.09: weight loading stalls at ~22 MB/s; setting NVreg_CoherentGPUMemoryMode=numa restores 50 s loads
summary: Two DGX Spark owners on the NVIDIA forum traced multi-minute to never-finishing vLLM and SGLang startups after the 615 driver update to the default CDMM coherent-memory mode; switching the nvidia module to NUMA mode loaded 21.9 GB in 50 s and cut a 123.6 GiB model's startup from over 48 min to about 6 min. Useful for anyone serving large checkpoints on a Spark.

appearances.title: RTX Spark Linux power cap workaround holds GPU throughput
appearances.summary: On an HP laptop, an RTX Spark chip fell from about 80 to 39.5 TFLOP/s under a long Linux load while plugged in, after its power limit dropped from 80W to 45W. Resending HP's power profile every minute held it around 73 to 75 TFLOP/s.
appearances.doubt: The linked issue carries an update dated 2026-11-05 withdrawing its physical-clock conversion and percent-of-peak claims; the TFLOP/s and power-limit numbers are not confirmed independently.
